title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal

An established and growing law firm is seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Commercial Property Paralegal to join its busy Commercial Property team.

Working closely with senior members of the department, you will support a varied caseload acting for landlords, tenants, property investors, businesses, developers and private clients. The team advises on a broad range of commercial property matters, including acquisitions and disposals, landlord and tenant work, commercial leases, property finance, development projects and property management across a variety of sectors.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Commercial Property Paralegal looking to further develop their technical expertise, gain greater responsibility and build strong client relationships within a supportive and forward-thinking legal practice.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing and progressing a varied caseload of commercial property matters from instruction through to completion.
- Assisting with commercial property acquisitions and disposals, including reviewing title documentation, raising and responding to enquiries, and progressing transactions to completion.
- Supporting landlord and tenant matters, including the preparation, review and completion of leases, licences, assignments, renewals and related documentation.
- Assisting with property finance transactions and associated security documentation.
- Undertaking and reviewing property searches, title documents, leases, CPSE enquiries and other due diligence requirements.
- Drafting, reviewing and amending commercial property documentation under appropriate supervision.
- Preparing reports on title, completion statements and transactional documents.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, agents, lenders, surveyors, accountants and other professional advisers.
- Managing key dates, deadlines and transaction timetables to ensure matters progress efficiently.
- Assisting with Land Registry applications, registrations and post-completion matters.
- Preparing and submitting SDLT returns and arranging payments where required.
- Ensuring compliance with SRA regulations, AML procedures and internal firm processes.
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper files and updating the case management system.
- Delivering a high level of client service and maintaining regular client communication throughout transactions.
- Supporting wider business development and networking activities where appropriate.

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience working as a Commercial Property Paralegal.
- Strong legal research, drafting and document review skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisational and time management abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities.
- The ability to work independently while recognising when to seek support and guidance.
- A professional, personable and client-focused approach.
- A genuine interest in developing a long-term career within commercial property law.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary of 28,000 - 32,000 DOE
- Performance-related incentives
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays
- Additional leave over the Christmas and New Year period
- Company pension scheme
- Private healthcare
- Supportive and professional working environment
- Modern office facilities
- Career progression opportunities
- Ongoing training, CPD and professional development
- Exposure to a varied and high-quality commercial property caseload
- Opportunities to build relationships with experienced legal professionals and clients
- Involvement in networking and business development initiatives

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join a progressive and ambitious law firm with a strong reputation for client service. The successful candidate will play a key role within a growing Commercial Property team and will be given the support and resources needed to develop their expertise and advance their career.

If you are an experienced Commercial Property Paralegal looking for your next challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
We are delighted to be partnering with a well-respected, established firm to recruit a Legal Assistant to join their Private Client team in Bedale.

This is a great opportunity to join a professional and supportive team. It suits an experienced Legal Assistant, or a strong legal administrator who is keen to build a career in Private Client work.

The Role

You'll provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to lawyers and legal staff, helping the department run smoothly and efficiently. You'll maintain accurate case files, coordinate diaries and meetings, and be a professional, friendly point of contact for clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing secretarial and administrative support to lawyers within the Private Client team
- Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, correspondence and reports
- Managing diaries, scheduling appointments and coordinating meetings via Outlook
- Maintaining well-organised electronic and paper filing systems
- Keeping case files complete, accurate and up to date
- Handling incoming calls and correspondence professionally and courteously
- Managing competing priorities to meet deadlines
- Providing reception cover during lunchtimes, holidays and other absences

About You

Essential:
- Experience as a Legal Secretary or in a similar administrative role, ideally within a legal environment
- Excellent typing skills and a high level of accuracy
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional, client-focused manner
- Able to work independently while contributing positively to a team

Desirable:
- Previous Private Client experience
- Experience using a legal case management system
- Experience supporting lawyers with client matters and legal documentation

Private Client experience isn't essential. Candidates with strong legal secretarial or administrative experience who are keen to develop in this area are also encouraged to apply.

Apply today or get in touch with Katie Kendall in our Northallerton office.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Sewell Wallis are excited to be working with a well respected law firm, based in Malton, North Yorkshire, who are looking for a Legal Secretary to join their busy Probate team. You'll be supporting fee earners across a varied caseload, helping to keep files organised, diaries under control and, most importantly, clients well looked after.

Although previous legal experience would be beneficial, we would welcome applicants with strong admin skills from any professional service.

What will you be doing?

You'll provide day-to-day secretarial and admin support to the Probate team, including:
- Preparing, formatting and amending correspondence, legal documents and reports.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments, meetings and calls.
- Handling incoming emails, post and telephone enquiries, making sure anything requiring legal input reaches the right fee earner.
- Opening, closing, maintaining and retrieving client files.
- Keeping case management systems and client records up to date.
- Preparing documents, copying, scanning and arranging outgoing post.
- Monitoring important probate and estate administration deadlines.
- Liaising with executors, beneficiaries, the Probate Registry, HMRC, banks and other third parties under the guidance of fee earners.
- Supporting with client onboarding, conflict checks, client identification, time recording and routine billing administration.
- Being a friendly, professional first point of contact for clients and external contacts.

What skills are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who has great administrative and organisation skills, whilst a background in legal services or probate would be advantageous

You'll also need:
- Fast and accurate audio and copy typing skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and a good eye for formatting.
- Strong Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel skills.
- Excellent spelling, grammar and written communication.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities.
- Confidence working independently while knowing when to ask for help or escalate something to a fee earner.
- A professional and discreet approach to confidential information.
- The ability to remain calm when things get busy.
- A genuine understanding of the importance of handling bereaved clients with sensitivity and empathy.

What's on offer?
- Salary of between 26000- 28000
- 20 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays (rising to 30 days) plus Christmas shutdown and birthday off.
- Company pension scheme
- Company sick pay
- Cycle to work scheme
- Employee referral scheme
- Discounted services
- Subsidised Parking

Please submit your CV to apply or contact Jemima Vibert for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. With offices in Sheffield and Leeds, we are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Residential Property Legal Secretary
description:
Residential Property Legal Secretary

Location: Malton
Salary: Up to 28,000, dependent on experience
Department: Residential Property

The Opportunity

An opportunity has arisen for a Residential Property Legal Secretary to join a professional and supportive legal team based in Malton.

The successful candidate will provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to fee earners within the residential property department, helping to ensure the smooth and efficient running of day-to-day operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive individual with strong administrative skills and an interest in residential property law. Previous legal secretarial experience is preferred, although training will be provided for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities
Legal Secretarial Support
- Provide accurate and efficient secretarial support to fee earners within the residential property department.
- Prepare correspondence and legal documents using digital dictation and word processing software.
- Manage diaries, arrange appointments and coordinate meetings.
- Assist with case-related financial records, accounts and invoices where required.
- Process instructions in line with established procedures and quality standards.
- Support colleagues within the secretarial team and assist with the training of junior or temporary staff where necessary.
- Provide reception cover during lunch breaks and periods of staff absence when required.

Document and File Management
- Open, maintain, close, store and retrieve client files.
- Ensure documents and client information are handled securely and confidentially.
- Prepare outgoing post and associated enclosures accurately and promptly.
- Undertake copying and document preparation duties as required.
- Maintain organised filing systems to support efficient departmental operations.

Client Care and Communication
- Welcome clients professionally and courteously, both in person and over the telephone.
- Handle client enquiries discreetly and ensure requests are dealt with promptly.
- Communicate effectively with fee earners, colleagues and clients.
- Maintain high standards of client care and professionalism at all times.

Teamwork and Organisation
- Prioritise workloads effectively to meet deadlines.
- Work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
- Demonstrate initiative and flexibility when responding to changing priorities.
- Maintain accuracy and attention to detail while working under pressure.
- Participate in training and development to enhance professional skills.

Skills and Experience

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous legal secretarial experience, ideally within residential property or conveyancing, although this is not essential.
- Strong audio and copy typing skills, with a high level of accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
- Excellent spelling, grammar and written communication skills.
- Familiarity with legal terminology and documentation.
- Good numerical skills and attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
- A professional and discreet approach to handling confidential information.
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Experience using legal case management systems would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of up to 28,000, dependent on experience.
- The opportunity to develop your skills within a residential property legal team.
- Training and support to help you succeed in the role.
- A varied position within a professional working environment.

If you have strong organisational skills, a proactive approach and an interest in residential property law, we would welcome your application.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.
